onboarding.welcomeLead: Three short steps — and your child only watches what you approve.
onboarding.step1Detail: On the dashboard — add a profile. A pairing code appears right away.
onboarding.step2Detail: Enter the code on the kid screen in the app.
onboarding.step3Detail: Search for a channel in «Manage channels» — only channels you approve will appear for the child.
onboarding.pinHint: Next we'll set a parent PIN (if not already set), then go to the dashboard with a quick-start guide.

setupGuide.title: Quick start
setupGuide.subtitle: Three steps and your child is already watching channels you approved.
setupGuide.completed: Initial setup is complete — safe viewing is ready.

setupGuide.stepPairDetail: Enter the 6-digit code on the kid screen.
setupGuide.stepChannelsDetail: Only channels you approve will appear for the child — this is the watching step.
